id.description: Existing agent id returned when the agent was created or listed.

run_in_background.description: If true, return immediately with a task_id. If the agent is busy, the message is queued regardless of this value. Use wait_until(task_id), then get_background_status(task_id) to inspect result.

bot_agent_id.description: External Agent instance from list_agent_backends. Mutually exclusive with model_id, provider, and fork. Omit for a native subagent.

fork.description: Native subagents only; omit with bot_agent_id. If true, inherit the parent model's current message context while keeping the subagent system prompt and tools.

id.description: Optional memorable agent id. If omitted, an id like agent_1 is assigned. Must be lowercase letters, digits, underscore, or hyphen.

model_id.description: Native subagents only; omit with bot_agent_id. Optional model name. Omit to use the native parent's model, or the Bot's configured chat model when the parent is external.

provider.description: Native subagents only; omit with bot_agent_id. Requires model_id and must match the native parent's provider, or the Bot's chat model provider when the parent is external.

run_in_background.description: If true, return immediately with a task_id. Use wait_until(task_id), then get_background_status(task_id) to inspect result.

task.description: Task instruction for the new agent.

id.description: Child agent_id returned by spawn_agent or list_agents.

run_id.description: Exact run_id from list_agents. A replacement run is never controlled.

action.description: Stop the specified run, or steer it when steer_supported is true.

message.description: Required for steer; the additional instruction for this run.
